name: Restaurant
description: Dine-in, takeout, and delivery food-service operations: floor plan and reservations, menu and kitchen order flow, point-of-sale payment, and the staff/inventory operations behind them.

sources.title: Frappe Hospitality
sources.notes: Reference-only (GPL-3.0). ERPNext restaurant module: Restaurant, Restaurant Table, Restaurant Menu/Menu Item, Restaurant Reservation, Restaurant Order Entry doctypes. Shared with domains/hospitality.

sources.title: Odoo Point of Sale + Restaurant addons (Community, addons/point_of_sale, addons/pos_restaurant)
sources.notes: Not cloned (monorepo, 17GB+, exceeds clone size cap; inspected via raw.githubusercontent.com). addons/ tree is Odoo Community, LGPL-3.0 per root LICENSE; pos_restaurant manifest confirms bill printing, bill splitting, kitchen order printing. Reference-only, no code copied.

sources.title: URY (ERPNext-based restaurant POS + Mosaic KDS)
sources.notes: Not cloned (inspected via GitHub API + raw FEATURES.md). Confirms visual table layout with drag-drop, table/captain transfer, bill splitting by item or custom split, takeaway order flow, KOT (kitchen order ticket) reprint. Reference-only, no code copied.

sources.title: PCI Data Security Standard v4.0.1
sources.license: PCI SSC copyright; free to read/download with registration
sources.notes: Card payment security standard; applies to any restaurant accepting card payments.

sources.title: EU Regulation No 1169/2011 on food information to consumers (allergen labelling)
sources.license: EU public document, free reuse per Commission Decision 2011/833/EU
sources.notes: EU-jurisdiction allergen/menu information disclosure requirement.

sources.title: US FDA Menu Labeling Requirements (21 CFR 101.11)
sources.notes: US chain-restaurant calorie/nutrition menu disclosure requirement.

sources.title: US DOL Fair Labor Standards Act — tipped employees / tip credit rules
sources.notes: One jurisdiction's example of tip/labor rules; cited as illustrative, not exhaustive — labour law varies sharply by country/state.

sources.title: satisfecho/pos (self-hosted multi-tenant restaurant POS and ordering)
sources.notes: Not cloned; inspected via `gh api .../git/trees` and `.../contents` (FastAPI/SQLModel backend in back/app/models.py, inventory_models.py, delivery_integration_routes.py, loyalty_wallet.py). Real, actively developed system (migrations dated through 2026-08) modelling Reservation/ReservationStatus, waitlist (front/src/app/waitlist-public), OrderChannel (table/satisfecho_delivery/marketplace) distinguishing first-party delivery from third-party marketplace integration (Uber Eats/Glovo/Deliveroo webhook adapters in delivery_integration_routes.py), Shift + attendance + QR clock-in, LoyaltyProgram/LoyaltyMembership/LoyaltyLedgerEntry/Apple-Google wallet passes, a Bill-of-Materials inventory model (FIFO batch costing, recipe ingredients), per-table QR ordering, and a guest-feedback/Google-review-url migration. GPL-family license (AGPL-3.0): reference-only, no code copied.

sources.title: Enatega Food Delivery (multivendor) monorepo
sources.notes: Not cloned; inspected via `gh api .../git/trees`. 1382-star MIT monorepo bundling customer, restaurant-admin, rider, and store apps for single- and multi-vendor food delivery, with schema/tipping.ts, schema/rider.ts, schema/delivery.ts, schema/zone.ts, and a ratings GraphQL query/UI (lib/api/graphql/queries/ratings) plus wallet/earnings screens for rider and restaurant payouts.

sources.title: RestoPOS (Laravel/Vue multi-tenant restaurant SaaS)
sources.notes: Not cloned; inspected via `gh api .../git/trees` and `.../contents` (Laravel migrations). tenants/domains tables (multi-tenant SaaS = multi-location chain management), locations/kitchens tables, suppliers/purchases/purchase_items/consumption_items (inventory), employees/employee_categories/attendance/employee_salaries (staff shifts), points table (loyalty), modifiers/food_modifier tables (menu modifiers), and a sales.type column explicitly coded dine-in/takeaway/delivery (`2022_05_26_023205_add_type_column_in_sales_table.php`, comment 'TAKEWAY = t').

sources.title: evan361425/flutter-pos-system (small-restaurant POS)
sources.notes: Not cloned; inspected via `gh api .../git/trees`. 619-star, actively maintained (pushed 2026-08) Flutter POS with lib/models/menu/product_ingredient.dart linking a sellable product to ingredient quantities (recipe/BOM), and lib/models/stock/ingredient.dart + stock/replenishment.dart + repository/stock.dart modelling stocked ingredients and restock events (inventory).

sources.title: Open Source Point of Sale (OSPOS)
sources.notes: Not cloned; inspected via `gh api .../git/trees` and `.../contents` (LICENSE file confirms MIT; GitHub's own license detector reports NOASSERTION for this repo, so the LICENSE text itself was read directly). 4405-star, actively maintained (pushed 2026-09-27) general retail/hospitality POS with app/Models/Giftcard.php (giftcard_number, value, person_id, deleted) — a real stored-value gift card model. General retail POS, not restaurant-specific; cited only for the gift card capability, which restaurants adopt from the same POS category.

sources.title: Square Node.js SDK (official vendor API client)
sources.notes: Not cloned; inspected via `gh api .../git/trees` (legacy/doc/api/*.md, generated from Square's own published API spec). Official vendor SDK for the Square POS/payments platform, documenting real, separately-billed API resources: orders.md + payments.md + terminal.md (third-party POS order/payment sync), gift-cards.md + gift-card-activities.md, loyalty.md, labor.md + employees.md + team.md (staff/shift), locations.md (multi-location), bookings.md (appointment-style reservations — evidences the concept of a hosted booking API, though Square Bookings targets appointment businesses generally rather than restaurant table reservations specifically, so not counted as restaurant-reservation corroboration).

features.name: Tables and floor plan
features.description: Define dining areas, tables, and seating capacity; visual floor-plan layout with per-table status (available, occupied, reserved, cleaning).

features.name: Menu management
features.description: Categories, items, prices, and availability windows for a restaurant's sellable menu.

features.name: Menu modifiers and variants
features.description: Add-ons, size options, ingredient substitutions, and combo choices attached to a menu item.

provenance.notes: Odoo POS has product attributes/combos; URY's item customization dialog supports comments/variants. Frappe's menu item is a flat item+rate with no modifier concept.

features.name: Table reservations
features.description: Book a table for a date/time and party size; capacity and time-window conflict checking.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations model reservations as a first-class entity with a status lifecycle (Frappe Hospitality's Restaurant Reservation DocType; satisfecho/pos's Reservation/ReservationStatus/PublicReservationCreate with floor/zone seating).

features.name: Walk-in waitlist
features.description: Queue walk-in parties without a reservation; estimated wait time and notify-when-ready.

provenance.notes: Second independent implementation confirms a walk-in waitlist distinct from booked reservations (satisfecho/pos ships a public waitlist page and dedicated waitlist-branding/feedback work), corroborating Frappe Hospitality.

features.name: Dine-in order taking
features.description: Capture an order against a table/seat, send to kitchen, and track status through to billing.

features.name: Kitchen display system (KDS)
features.description: Route order tickets to kitchen stations, track prep status, and flag delayed items in real time.

provenance.notes: Odoo pos_restaurant documents 'Kitchen Order Printing'; URY has KOT (kitchen order ticket) reprint. Neither is a screen-based KDS in the parts reviewed — ticket printing and true KDS are treated as the same underlying feature at different fidelity.

features.name: POS integration
features.description: Connect to or embed a point-of-sale system for order capture and payment settlement.

provenance.notes: The three restaurant-management sources are themselves the POS rather than an integration to one. Square's official SDK (orders/payments/terminal APIs) is added as direct evidence that connecting to a third-party POS for order and payment sync is a real, separately-implemented integration surface at a major vendor.

features.name: In-restaurant payment capture
features.description: Charge a table's bill through a payment provider; supports pay-at-table and receipt printing.

features.name: Split bills
features.description: Divide a table's bill by item, by seat, or evenly across a party.

features.name: Tips and gratuity
features.description: Capture tip amount at payment and record it against the server/order for payout and reporting.

provenance.notes: Three independent implementations model tip capture as a distinct concern: Frappe Hospitality, satisfecho/pos (tenant tip presets and per-order tip attribution), and Enatega (schema/tipping.ts).

features.name: Takeout / pickup orders
features.description: Orders placed for customer pickup rather than dine-in; no table assignment.

provenance.notes: Second independent implementation confirms takeout/pickup as a distinct order type (RestoPOS's sales.type column is explicitly coded dine-in/takeaway/delivery).

features.name: Delivery orders
features.description: Orders fulfilled by delivery to a customer address, with own or third-party couriers.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations model first-party delivery concretely: satisfecho/pos's OrderChannel.satisfecho_delivery plus a delivery/courier order service, and Enatega's dedicated rider app and delivery/zone schema for restaurant-run delivery.

features.name: Third-party delivery marketplace integration
features.description: Publish menu and receive orders from delivery marketplaces (e.g. aggregator apps).

provenance.notes: satisfecho/pos implements this concretely: OrderChannel.marketplace plus delivery_integration_routes.py, a real admin API and public webhook ingest for Uber Eats, Glovo, and Deliveroo with per-provider credentials and connection-status tracking. Only one implementation was found (Enatega builds a first-party delivery platform rather than integrating a third-party one), so this stays at medium rather than high.

features.name: Ingredient inventory
features.description: Track stock levels of ingredients and supplies used to prepare menu items.

provenance.notes: Three independent implementations model ingredient/stock inventory: satisfecho/pos (FIFO batch costing, purchase orders, Bill of Materials), RestoPOS (suppliers/purchases/purchase_items/consumption_items), and flutter-pos-system (stock/ingredient + replenishment).

features.name: Recipes and yield
features.description: Bill-of-materials per menu item: ingredient quantities and yield, used to cost dishes and deplete stock.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations link a sellable menu item to ingredient quantities: satisfecho/pos's explicit 'Bill of Materials - links sellable products to inventory ingredients' model, and flutter-pos-system's product_ingredient.dart.

features.name: Staff shift scheduling
features.description: Plan and publish staff work shifts and track clock-in/clock-out.

provenance.notes: Three independent sources: satisfecho/pos (Shift model, QR clock-in/out, work-session breaks), RestoPOS (attendance and employee_salaries tables), and Square's official labor/employees/team API.

features.name: Loyalty and rewards
features.description: Points, punch cards, or tiered rewards tied to a guest's order history.

provenance.notes: Three independent sources model points/rewards as a first-class concern: satisfecho/pos (LoyaltyProgram, LoyaltyMembership, LoyaltyLedgerEntry, Apple/Google wallet pass issuance), RestoPOS (a dedicated points table), and Square's official loyalty API. URY's 'favourite items' feature was dropped from this list — it is not a points/rewards program and does not corroborate this feature.

features.name: Customer reviews and ratings
features.description: Collect and display post-visit ratings/feedback tied to an order or visit.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations: satisfecho/pos (a guest-feedback and Google-review-url migration) and Enatega (a dedicated ratings schema, GraphQL query, and admin UI).

features.name: Online ordering
features.description: Customer-facing web/app storefront for takeout and delivery ordering against the live menu.

provenance.notes: Two independent implementations of guest-facing online ordering: satisfecho/pos's public menu/order endpoints and Enatega's customer app.

features.name: Allergen and nutrition labelling
features.description: Flag allergens and (where required) publish calorie/nutrition information per menu item.

features.name: QR code table ordering
features.description: Guests scan a table QR code to view the menu and order from their own device.

provenance.notes: satisfecho/pos implements per-table QR ordering concretely (public QR-to-menu links, shared cart per table, QR order history), corroborating the general online-ordering pattern described by the secondary source.

features.name: Gift cards
features.description: Sell and redeem stored-value gift cards.

provenance.notes: opensourcepos's Giftcard model (giftcard_number, value, person_id) is a concrete stored-value implementation, corroborating the general description. General retail POS, not restaurant-specific — noted honestly rather than claimed as a restaurant implementation.

features.name: Self-service kiosk ordering
features.description: In-store kiosk for customers to browse the menu, order, and pay without staff assistance.

provenance.notes: Reasoned inference; common commercial pattern, not verified against an inspected open-source implementation.

features.name: Multi-location management
features.description: Manage menus, pricing, and reporting across a chain of restaurant locations from one account.

provenance.notes: Three independent sources model multi-location/multi-tenant chain management: Frappe Hospitality, RestoPOS (tenants/domains/locations tables), and Square's official locations API.
